visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + text + link + list + button + video + image
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Office location details (address, phone, fax, description) beside a map

contentPattern.structure: One row, two cells. Cell 1: heading, address paragraph(s) linked to Google Maps, a bulleted list of Phone / Toll Free / Fax lines, optional description heading and paragraphs. Cell 2 (optional): a Google Maps embed link (/maps/embed or /maps/d/embed), any Google Maps link, or a map picture; when empty the first address is embedded automatically. An 'Open location in Maps' link is added under the map

usage: Office location pages (/offices/*) and local landing pages listing one or more office addresses next to a map.
reuseGuidance: Use for any address + map pairing. Use grey for multi-office lists beside a Google My Maps embed, image when the map is authored as a static picture. Person contact details belong in profile-contact.
